title: Data Provenance and Ethics in the Curricula of U.S. Health AI Education Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.39606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Failures of deployed clinical artificial intelligence (AI) systems have often originated in how their training data were generated. Whether the programs that train the health AI workforce teach practitioners to examine data provenance is unknown. We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of the publicly advertised curricula of health AI education programs at U.S. universities, identified through a structured multisource web search between April and July 2026. Two investigators coded coverage of data provenance (structural, dataset limitations, or data management only), ethics, and sustainability; collaborative structure; technical prerequisites; and the disciplinary background and gender of named instructors. The primary outcome was provenance coverage at the structural or dataset-limitations level. Of 43 candidate entries, 36 programs at 25 institutional units in 21 universities were included. translated_title: 美国健康人工智能教育项目课程中的数据来源与伦理问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.39606v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：已部署的临床人工智能（AI）系统的失败往往源于其训练数据的生成方式。然而，培养健康AI人才的教育项目是否教导从业者审查数据来源尚不清楚。我们对美国大学健康AI教育项目公开发布的课程进行了横断面分析，这些项目是通过2026年4月至7月间结构化的多来源网络搜索确定的。两名研究者对以下内容进行了编码：数据来源的覆盖情况（结构性层面、数据集局限性层面或仅涉及数据管理）、伦理和可持续性内容、协作结构、技术先修要求，以及署名讲师的学科背景和性别。主要结局指标是在结构性或数据集局限性层面的数据来源覆盖情况。在43个候选条目中，共纳入21所大学25个机构单位的36个项目。其中29个项目涵盖伦理内容（80.6%；9…
tldr: 该研究对美国大学健康AI教育项目的课程进行横断面分析，发现尽管大多数项目涵盖伦理内容，但对数据来源（尤其是结构性层面的数据溯源分析）的教学覆盖不足，揭示了健康AI人才培养中数据溯源教育的缺口。
en_tdlr: A cross-sectional analysis of U.S. health AI education curricula shows that while ethics is widely taught (80.6% of programs), instruction on data provenance—particularly at the structural level—remains insufficient, exposing a gap in training practitioners to examine how AI training data are generated.
